snapshot.text: Tax-funded universal system centred on Landspítali university hospital, whose new main building in Reykjavík is under construction. Capacity for nursing homes and regional hospitals is being expanded.

priorities.title: New Landspítali buildings
priorities.text: Construction of the new national hospital continues, including a new mental health facility.

priorities.title: Nursing home places
priorities.text: 100 new nursing home places opened in 2026.
